_comment: agy tool names advertised in the init event of real `agy --output-format stream-json` runs. Cross-checked 2026-08-26 against a real `agy --version` 1.1.21 run on the host macOS install (real account, not the container's) -- identical 57-tool set both times, so the drop is not an artifact of the container/account used for the other captures.
